items.title: William Russell Interview, 1976-02-16
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Paul Barnes kept a journal way, way back. Paul Barnes, who I would like to talk to. It's a shame we lost that.

ctx.x: Used to write all these articles for the Hot Jazz, Panacea's Magazine, back in the early, not necessarily early 30s, the middle 30s in particular. By 1935 or so, he was maybe before. I don't know how long before.
Paul Barnes kept a journal way, way back. Paul Barnes, who I would like to talk to. It's a shame we lost that.

George Gaynor could have written stuff. He was a pretty good writer. He could write poetry, and the song lyrics maybe aren't too original, but in short stories. He did have even short stories published, I know.
